name: Lumen
look: a tiny dawn-light fairy no bigger than a hand, translucent gold-and-pink dragonfly wings, a soft pearl glow in its small body and a trail of fine sparkles
temperament: Curious, gentle and quick to laugh; it chimes rather than speaks and never strays far from her shoulder
scenePlacement: hovering beside her raised hand, a trail of golden sparkles behind it
notes: Test-bed creature for Angel Primes; never a dragon (the Elder Dragons are the Drakn line). Use it to try creature art, then move what works into the main roster.
